definitions.explanation: The act of loading goods or cargo onto a vehicle, ship, or container.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}の{積|つ}み{込|こ}みが{終|お}わった。
examples.english: The loading of the luggage is finished.

examples.japanese: {積|つ}み{込|こ}み{作業|さぎょう}は{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}に{行|おこな}われる。
examples.english: The loading work is done in the morning.

examples.japanese: トラックへの{積|つ}み{込|こ}みには{二時間|にじかん}かかった。
examples.english: Loading onto the truck took two hours.

notes:
{積|つ}み{込|こ}み is the noun form of the verb {積|つ}み{込|こ}む (to load). It refers to the act or process of loading cargo.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {積|つ}み{込|こ}み{作業|さぎょう} (loading work/operation)
- {積|つ}み{込|こ}み{完了|かんりょう} (loading complete)
- {積|つ}み{込|こ}み{開始|かいし} (start of loading)

RELATED TERMS:
- {積|つ}み{込|こ}む (to load) - verb form
- {積|つ}み{下|お}ろし (unloading) - opposite action
